en.hubeali:
And in another report – Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Benefit (yourself) by the hide of the sacrificed animal, and buy the provisions with it, and if you were to give in charity with it, so it would be superior’.

And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> sacrificed a camel and did not give the butcher its hide, nor its collar, nor its decor (reins etc.), but he<sup>saww</sup> gave it in charity (instead); and do not give the butcher anything from it, but give him from other than that’.
en.sarwar: 2. In the narration of Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar from abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, it is said that
the hide of animal for offering can be used for beneficial purposes or purchase thereby goods, but to give them as charity is better.

He (the Imam) said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, slaughtered a badanah and did not give its hide to butchers or the decorative items but gave them as charity. You must not give the hide to those who skin animals, but give them from other things.’”
